# opnsense_nginx_errorpage (Resource)

Custom nginx error pages (**Services ▸ Nginx ▸ Configuration ▸ HTTP(S) ▸ Error Pages**, plugin `os-nginx`), used by HTTP servers and locations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_nginx_errorpage" "maintenance" {
  name        = "maintenance"
  statuscodes = ["502", "503", "504"]
  pagecontent = file("${path.module}/maintenance.html")
  response    = "503"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Enter a name for your error page.
- `statuscodes` (Set of String) Enter the HTTP status codes for which the error page shall be shown. One of `400`, `401`, `403`, `404`, `405`, `407`, `408`, `410`, `415`, `429`, `431`, `500`, `501`, `502`, `503`, `504`.

### Optional

- `pagecontent` (String) The HTML page content to display. Defaults to ``.
- `redirect` (String) Instead of displaying a static error page redirect to a URL. Defaults to ``.
- `response` (String) Optionally enter a HTTP status code to change the response to. This does not work in combination with a redirection target. One of `200`, `300`, `301`, `302`, `401`, `403`, `404`, `451`, `500`, `503`. Defaults to ``.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the nginx error page.
